description: One call that runs mail-auth, HTTP header audit, HSTS, on-page SEO, robots.txt and RDAP for a domain and returns a single 0-100 scored report plus a human-readable summary. A failed check is reported and skipped; the others still run. Returns { domain, url, score, grade, summary, checks, failures }: overall 0-100 score and grade, a plain-language summary, per-check results, and any checks that failed. Price: 20 credits (1 credit = 1 US cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

domain.description: Public domain name, e.g. example.com; IP literals and private suffixes (.local, .internal, .lan, .corp) are refused.

url.description: Optional page URL for SEO and robots checks. Defaults to https://<domain>/.

name: site-audit
title: Site security and SEO audit
